newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments reach 26.753 mln T.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments reach 26.753 mln T.

text.p: European Union grain export commitments up to May 27 rose 61 percent over last year, official figures showed on Friday.

Figures supplied by member country officials showed grain earmarked for export between July 1, 1996 and May 27, 1997 totalled 26.753 million tonnes against 16.628 million during the same period last year.
Exports of commercial soft wheat grain reached 9.787 million tonnes against 5.653 million a year ago. Soft wheat flour exports jumped to 5.772 million tonnes from 3.819 million.
Barley exports reached 6.181 million tonnes against 1.723 million tonnes.
On Thursday the European Union granted the export of 5,000 tonnes of oats from the open market in the last weekly export tender of the season.

It also cut the tax applying to daily soft wheat grain exports to five Ecus per tonne and the tax on daily soft wheat flour exports to seven Ecus but maintained the tax on durum wheat grain exports at 10 Ecus.

It also decided that a "nil value" or "dash" would apply to non-tax business through the daily export channel. The change excludes exports of rye flour which remain at a standing refund of 30 Ecus per tonne.
